description: S51 T2 (TM5): one bug's audit, newest-first — the acts, each fixed-template summary, and the actor who made each. This is the table bug_change read back: a person asking WHAT HAPPENED TO THIS BUG and the answer naming who did it (user/cli/agent/system, TM2). The history of a real bug with no rows answers EMPTY — that is a different fact from an id that never was, which answers ErrTriageUnknown (see history-unknown.json).
